title: Friend's government contact warns him off the Kandahar giant

tellings.quote: asked him he said hey do you know anything about like this Kandahar giant thing and he said this person who's his friend just totally switched

plain: A friend of a filmmaker named Tim Alberino asked a government contact about the Kandahar giant, a story that US soldiers met and killed a giant near Kandahar, Afghanistan, and the contact's manner changed completely as he warned him off. Alberino relays this as what his friend told him. He tells it as a sign that the story touches something officials want kept quiet.
